free.title: Serbest sohbet
free.prompt: Free conversation. Chat about the learner's day, their work and their interests like a friend.

interview.title: İş görüşmesi
interview.description: İş görüşmesi · Alex, {field} pozisyonu için mülakatçı
interview.prompt: Role-play: you are a friendly interviewer for a {field} job. Ask one interview question at a time (experience, a hard problem they solved, why this job). Stay in character.

restaurant.title: Restoran
restaurant.description: Restoran · Alex garson, sen sipariş veriyorsun
restaurant.prompt: Role-play: you are a waiter in a casual restaurant. The learner is the customer. Greet them, take their order, ask about drinks and allergies, suggest a dessert. Stay in character.
